children: Xphere's additional 35M XP pool is fully filled, so the reward vault reaches its 70M XP cap. From now on, 40% or more of daily validator rewards burn forever, with up to 60% of those rewards going to stakers.

With the vault full, XP gains a permanent deflationary mechanism tied to validator activity. Each day, a fixed share of rewards is removed from circulation rather than distributed, while stakers receive up to 60% of the remainder. This shifts the token's emission profile toward supply reduction and gives staking a larger slice of daily output. The actual burn scale depends on unstated daily reward levels, so the size of the effect varies with network payout volumes.
Additional 35M XP — FULLY FILLED in record time.
Vault now at 100% of its 70M XP cap.
From here, 40%+ of daily validator rewards burn forever.

title: Xphere: Validator Reward Burn Activates as XP Vault Hits 70M Cap - 24 Sep 2026
